scripts.dev:clean: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$ports = 3000,3001; foreach ($port in $ports) { $conns = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort $port -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; foreach ($conn in $conns) { Stop-Process -Id $conn.OwningProcess -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } }; if (Test-Path .next) { Remove-Item .next -Recurse -Force }; npx next dev -p 3000"
scripts.build:clean: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$ports = 3000,3001; foreach ($port in $ports) { $conns = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort $port -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; foreach ($conn in $conns) { Stop-Process -Id $conn.OwningProcess -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } }; if (Test-Path .next) { Remove-Item .next -Recurse -Force }; npx next build"
